verdict.rationale: Angular provides an official CLI (documented at angular.dev/cli) with a `ng new` command that creates a new workspace, plus serve/build/test commands, and docs advertise "Get started in 5 minutes" alongside an in-browser tutorial for zero-setup exploration. This matches the story of scaffolding and running a new project quickly via official tooling. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on timing benchmarks or third-party confirmation of the actual scaffold speed beyond first-party docs.
